description: This line plot, titled “Performance w.r.t. Temperature,” illustrates the accuracy, measured in Pass@8, for three different methods—“On-policy RL,” “SFT,” and a third unlabeled red line—as a function of temperature, which ranges from 0.1 to 1.0 along the x-axis. The y-axis represents accuracy in Pass@8, scaled linearly from 62.5 to 80.0. The “On-policy RL” method is depicted by a yellow line with triangle markers that generally trends upward from approximately 64.0 at temperature 0.1 to a peak near 75.0 at temperature 0.8, then declines slightly to around 73.0 at temperature 1.0. The “SFT” method is shown as a teal line with triangle markers, starting near 75.0 at temperature 0.1, decreasing to around 70.0 at temperature 0.5, then rising again to approximately 74.0 at temperature 1.0. The unlabeled red line, which appears to be the “On-policy RL” line in the legend, starts at approximately 77.0 at temperature 0.1, rises to about 79.0 at temperature 0.2, then fluctuates with minor dips and peaks, ending near 80.0 at temperature 1.0. All lines are plotted with solid lines and triangular markers, and the x-axis tick labels are spaced at intervals of 0.1.
